prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply recommendation system expertise to this task". The fixture contains version/runtime ambiguity, a tempting shortcut, a compatibility edge case, and a failure path that distinguishes real expertise from generic completion. The acceptance boundary is recommendation-ranking: Define the user/product objective, candidate set, ranking stages, feedback event semantics, position/exposure bias, freshness, diversity, constraints, and exploration policy. The adjacent embedding-systems discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: time-stamped marketplace impressions/feedback and candidate snapshots with inventory/eligibility
fixed ANN candidates/embeddings plus old/new ranking outputs and delayed conversion labels
seller/category/freshness and cold-start cohorts with slate-constraint fixtures
offline/online feature snapshots, shadow/canary serving traces and rollback controls
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual recommendation-ranking boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=implementation; near-neighbor=embedding-systems), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define the user/product objective, candidate set, ranking stages, feedback event semantics, position/exposure bias, freshness, diversity, constraints, and exploration policy.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Evaluate offline on temporally correct splits and meaningful slices, then use controlled online experiments where authorized.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not optimize click-through alone, use future leakage, interpret observational uplift as causal, or let popular-item bias erase cold-start and long-tail users/items.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Objective, candidate eligibility/stages, exposure/event semantics and point-in-time feature identity; Temporal leakage-safe data plus retrieval/ranking/cold-start/long-tail/diversity and guardrail metrics; Logged-policy/exploration propensity or explicit observational limitation plus controlled online experiment evidence; Train-serving parity, fallback, feedback-loop, launch and rollback artifacts), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
